question: Can the cited 2005 CLSU Biodiversity volume and its Nueva Ecija freshwater-fish chapters be retrieved and independently reviewed to resolve field dates, site-level fish assignments, or the relationship among the 2005, 2006 NAST, and 2009 Silliman outputs?

metadataLimits: The accessible 2009 reference list does not give chapter pagination or ISBN.
No item-level record independently verified the edition, total page count, holdings, or author-supplied digital copy.

repositoryDiscovery.officialLibraryPageObservation: The CLSU University Library and Information Services page identifies the OPAC as its Online Public Access Catalog and links to the catalog for searching library collections.
repositoryDiscovery.accessResult: The OPAC root and a direct title-query URL could not be retrieved in this browser session (HTTP 502/unavailable). Exact-title and author web-index searches surfaced citations to the volume but no item-level catalog record or accessible copy.
repositoryDiscovery.interpretation: A failed catalog request and an unsuccessful bounded search do not show that the volume or a catalog record does not exist.

lineageAssessment.documented: The 2009 publisher-hosted article's reference list explicitly cites the 2005 edited volume and separate freshwater-fish chapters on endemic/indigenous and introduced taxa.
lineageAssessment.relationshipToExistingReviews: The earlier 2006 NAST abstract and 2009 Silliman article share authors, five Nueva Ecija study waters, sampling design, and fish-name leads. The cited 2005 chapter trail is a plausible common antecedent, but no retrieved 2005 text, field log, or author-supported dataset proves whether the outputs reuse, extend, or independently resample the same material.
lineageAssessment.decision: Do not count the 2005, 2006, and 2009 references as independent confirmations or sum their reported richness. Do not infer any species-by-waterbody mapping from these citations.

rightsAndDisposition.rights: No item-specific reuse terms for the 2005 volume or chapters were found.
rightsAndDisposition.contentHandling: Only concise bibliographic metadata from the official 2009 publisher reference list is recorded. No chapter text, table, figure, photo, underlying data, or protected expression is copied.

nextActions: Retry the CLSU OPAC title/author query through the official library route when it is available; record any catalog record, call number, holding, and access terms without assuming online full text.
Search for a lawfully available author/institution-hosted copy of the two cited chapters and preserve the source version, date, station design, species matrix, vouchers, and reuse terms if found.
Keep the linked 2005, 2006, and 2009 works research-only and non-independent until primary materials establish their dataset lineage and site-level evidence.
